similar_in_english: Innocent in matters of the flesh
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মন অচন্দ্রচেতন, কোনো যৌন অনুভূতি নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: Her mind is achandrachetan, completely lacking any sexual awareness.
Everyone is achandrachetan in their childhood.
note: This idiom metaphorically uses 'moon' to symbolize sensuality or desire in Bengali poetic tradition.
